categories.title: Item Box
categories.info: Used to store items. They're linked, so anything you put in one item box will appear in all others.

categories.title: Microscope
categories.info: Can be used to scan blood samples, unlocking new crafting recipes for Grace.

categories.title: Power Distributor
categories.info: Activated with Joint Plugs. Doing so will open doors and turn on lights, which The Girl doesn't particularly like.

categories.title: Supply Box
categories.info: Exclusive to Leon. Kill enemies or find Tracking Modules for points, then exchange them for items and upgrades.

categories.title: Antique Coin
categories.info: Antique Coins can only be picked up by Grace, and are used to purchase items in the Parlor. Their only use afterwards is to be turned into scrap.

categories.title: Blood Specimen
categories.info: Bring them to microscopes and complete a minigame to unlock new crafting recipes for Grace.

categories.title: Charm
categories.info: Leon can attach charms to his guns, and Grace gains the benefits just by carrying them. Any charms you've found will be carried over into new game plus.

categories.title: Hip Pouch
categories.info: Hip Pouches increase Grace's inventory space by 2 slots.

categories.title: Map
categories.info: Examine maps to have your in-game map updated.

categories.title: Mr Raccoon
categories.info: Destroy all 25 Mr. Raccoon statues to unlock the third tier of weapon upgrades for Leon.

categories.title: Safe
categories.info: Safe combinations are not random, but they do change when playing on Insanity difficulty.

categories.title: Weapon Upgrade
categories.info: You'll get two for free, but other weapon upgrades are purchased from supply boxes.

categories.title: 12.7x55mm Ammo
categories.info: Ammunition used by Requiem.

categories.title: Hemolytic Injector
categories.info: The first one's free, but you'll need Scrap and Infected Blood to craft additional injectors (after scanning [Blood Specimen (Denatured)](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541196)). They can be used to instantly kill unaware enemies, and prevent dead enemies from becoming Blister Heads.

categories.title: Ink Ribbon
categories.info: Used to save the game at typewriters on Standard (Classic) and Insanity difficulty. Ink Ribbon Tins can be turned into Ink Ribbons with 40 Infected Blood.

categories.title: Knife
categories.info: Used to escape grabs, create scrap, or poke enemies until they stop moving.

categories.title: Random Pickup
categories.info: Random items based on whatever the game thinks you need most.

categories.title: Tracking Module
categories.info: Tracking Modules grant points which can be exchanged for items and upgrades at any Supply Box.

categories.title: Empty Bottle
categories.info: Can be thrown as a noisy distraction or used in crafting.

categories.title: Empty Injector
categories.info: Used to craft steroids and stabilizers after analyzing the [Blood Specimen (Reversible)](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541326)

categories.title: Gunpowder
categories.info: Can be used to craft all kinds of ammunition as Leon.

categories.title: Infected Blood
categories.info: Gather infected blood with the [Blood Collector](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541194) to craft items as Grace.

categories.title: Rare Metal
categories.info: Used to craft 12.7x55mm ammo when combined with infected blood (after scanning the [Blood Specimen (Converged)](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541309)) -- found [here](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=542387) on Insanity difficulty.

categories.title: Breakable
categories.info: Breakables contain random items based on whatever the game thinks you need most.

categories.title: Seedling
categories.info: Destroy every Seedling to complete the Not Today, Buds! challenge.

categories.title: Warped Closet
categories.info: Warped closets can only be opened by Leon's big ole' biceps.
